maintenance_led.reason: Freight forwarding, customs brokerage and warehousing move customers' new shipments; not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private importers/exporters such as Goodyear, Nissan, Toyota and retailers paying for freight and logistics.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically through its own global network and technology; known for few acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Freight forwarding and customs services are competitive; shippers can move lanes between forwarders, despite some integration with customer systems.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call, since customs compliance and integrated systems add some switching friction.
